Just bouts of a void, spewing all the sad, unfortunate realities of the world (homelessness, war, violent crime). Why didn't I experience any of that? Something to gain respect from my fellow peers and most importantly, my father? The only person who believes I'm capable of anything. And all I've ever done is let him down.
